verdict.rationale: No first-party GitLab documentation on webhooks is in the pack. Webhook-based event delivery is only implied by partner-directory listings: Make says to "utilize webhooks, actions, and triggers", a docs tool describes "continuous docs build using Webhook", and the PagerDuty and Zulip integrations receive GitLab events and notifications. Missing for 10: first-party webhook docs (event types, configuration, payload schemas, delivery and retry semantics, secret verification), any API for managing webhooks, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
